explication: Octomind is a Rust coding-agent harness: a user starts a session through a CLI or one of several documented interfaces, supplies a task, and the agent uses models and MCP tools to work in a repository. The documented turn includes context assembly, policy checks, tool execution, supervision and verification; sessions can also compress history and retain learned lessons. README descriptions establish the domain flow and capabilities; source-index references and excerpts provide only partial implementation wiring, so unsampled links are omitted.
